structs.name: BatchRollups
structs.doc: BatchRollups holds the fields a Batch's Rollups adds, as a read returns them: a field with no value is absent.

members.name: Values
members.doc: Each rollup's value, by name, computed when the instance is read: a count, counts by value, a number, a field's value, or a boolean. A rollup whose link holds more than 500 instances is {"over": true} instead; a min or max with no value to compare, and a latest whose instance holds none, is absent.

structs.name: BatchRollupsValues
structs.doc: BatchRollupsValues types BatchRollups.values.

members.name: Jobs

members.name: Status

structs.name: JobLease
structs.doc: JobLease holds the fields a Job's Lease adds, as a read returns them: a field with no value is absent.

members.name: Holder
members.doc: The subject of the principal that holds the lease; absent when the instance is free.

members.name: Token
members.doc: The fencing token. It advances at every acquire, release and expiry, and a write under the lease presents it.

members.name: AcquiredAt
members.doc: When the lease was acquired, in epoch milliseconds; absent when the instance is free.

members.name: RenewedAt
members.doc: Its acquire or its last heartbeat, in epoch milliseconds; absent when the instance is free.

members.name: ExpiresAt
members.doc: When the lease expires unless it is renewed, in epoch milliseconds; absent when the instance is free.

members.name: Active
members.doc: Whether a lease is held and has not expired.

members.name: Expiries
members.doc: How many leases have expired or been abandoned since the last resetExpiries.

members.name: Ended
members.doc: How and when the last lease ended (reason and at); absent while one is held.

structs.name: JobLeaseEnded
structs.doc: JobLeaseEnded types JobLease.ended.

structs.name: JobAssignment
structs.doc: JobAssignment holds the fields a Job's Assignment adds, as a read returns them: a field with no value is absent.

members.name: Assignee
members.doc: The principal the instance is assigned to; absent when it is unassigned.

structs.name: JobBudget
structs.doc: JobBudget holds the fields a Job's Budget adds, as a read returns them: a field with no value is absent.

members.name: Meters
members.doc: Each meter, by name: used, reserved (this instance's own reservation and what it holds for the instances inside it), limit and remaining (limit minus used and reserved), limit and remaining null when the meter has no limit. A daily meter whose day has passed shows used 0.

structs.name: JobBudgetMeters
structs.doc: JobBudgetMeters types JobBudget.meters.

structs.name: JobBudgetMetersCalls
structs.doc: JobBudgetMetersCalls types JobBudgetMeters.calls.

structs.name: JobBudgetMetersCpuSeconds
structs.doc: JobBudgetMetersCpuSeconds types JobBudgetMeters.cpuSeconds.

structs.name: JobRetries
structs.doc: JobRetries holds the fields a Job's Retries adds, as a read returns them: a field with no value is absent.

members.name: Total
members.doc: Failures counted.

members.name: ClassAttempts
members.doc: Failures counted, by failure class.

members.name: BestScore
members.doc: The score of the kept result; absent when no scored result is kept.

members.name: Exhausted
members.doc: Whether the instance has run out of attempts.

members.name: Stuck
members.doc: Whether the instance failed with the same signature stuckAfter times in a row.

structs.name: JobRetriesClassAttempts
structs.doc: JobRetriesClassAttempts types JobRetries.classAttempts.

members.name: Fields
members.doc: The last value settled for each derived field, by field: { sourceHash, model, settledAt, settledBy, confidence? }, and overridden: { by, at } once a caller or another behavior's operation wrote it. A field with neither is absent.

members.name: Stale
members.doc: The derived fields whose inputs, instruction, model or type moved since their last value, or that rederive asked for, and that no write overrode, in the config's order.

structs.doc: RequestProvenance holds the fields a Request's Provenance adds, as a read returns them: a field with no value is absent.

members.name: Fields
members.doc: By recorded field written since Provenance was added: { source, by, at, confidence?, review? }. source is caller for a caller's create or update, else the name of the behavior whose operation wrote it; by is the principal's subject; review is { state, by?, at? }, state proposed, accepted, rejected or edited.

members.name: InReview
members.doc: Whether any recorded field is proposed. A list filters on it.

structs.name: TicketWorkflow
structs.doc: TicketWorkflow holds the fields a Ticket's Workflow adds, as a read returns them: a field with no value is absent.

members.name: Status
members.doc: The state the instance is in.

structs.name: TicketComments
structs.doc: TicketComments holds the fields a Ticket's Comments adds, as a read returns them: a field with no value is absent.

members.name: Messages
members.doc: How many posted and interrupted messages the conversation has, top-level and replies; composing, deleted and purged ones are not counted.

members.name: LastMessageAt
members.doc: The greatest postedAt of a posted or interrupted message, in epoch milliseconds; absent while there is none.

members.name: Threads
members.doc: The posted and interrupted top-level messages, each a thread, whether resolved or not: { open, resolved }.

members.name: Composing
members.doc: The subjects writing a message now: each subject with a composing message on the instance, once, in the order of its earliest composing message's id; empty while nobody is.

structs.name: TicketCommentsThreads
structs.doc: TicketCommentsThreads types TicketComments.threads.

structs.doc: TicketRevisions holds the fields a Ticket's Revisions adds, as a read returns them: a field with no value is absent.

members.name: Revision
members.doc: The number of the instance's latest revision.

members.name: PendingProposals
members.doc: With review in the config, how many of the instance's proposals are pending; absent without review.

structs.name: TicketDependencies
structs.doc: TicketDependencies holds the fields a Ticket's Dependencies adds, as a read returns them: a field with no value is absent.

members.name: Blocked
members.doc: Whether a blocker is not finished: its status is not a terminal state of its schema's Workflow whose outcome the config accepts.

structs.doc: TicketLinks holds the fields a Ticket's Links adds, as a read returns them: a field with no value is absent.

members.name: Targets
members.doc: The links the instance holds, by name: each target's schema and id, and for a pinned link the revision or the release it records, the target's latest and whether the target has moved past it; for a many-valued link, a list of them in the order they were linked. Absent when the instance holds none.

structs.name: TicketLinksTargets
structs.doc: TicketLinksTargets types TicketLinks.targets.

members.name: Project
members.doc: The projects instance project points at.

members.name: Reviewers
members.doc: The people instances reviewers points at, in the order they were linked.

members.name: Spec
members.doc: The documents instance spec points at.

structs.name: TicketLinksTargetsProject
structs.doc: TicketLinksTargetsProject types TicketLinksTargets.project.

structs.name: TicketLinksTargetsReviewersItem
structs.doc: TicketLinksTargetsReviewersItem types an item of TicketLinksTargets.reviewers.

structs.name: TicketLinksTargetsSpec
structs.doc: TicketLinksTargetsSpec types TicketLinksTargets.spec.

members.name: Latest
members.doc: The target's latest revision.

members.name: Revision
members.doc: The target's revision the link records.

members.name: Stale
members.doc: Whether the target has moved past that revision.

structs.name: TicketTimers
structs.doc: TicketTimers holds the fields a Ticket's Timers adds, as a read returns them: a field with no value is absent.

members.name: Deadlines
members.doc: Each started deadline, by name: { dueAt, fired, firedAt?, outcome? }, when it is due, in epoch milliseconds, whether it has fired and when, and what its then met: moved, skipped (the status was not one it moves from), vetoed or forbidden. A deadline not started, or cancelled, is absent. Nothing in it follows the clock: a deadline is overdue while it has not fired and its dueAt has passed.

structs.name: TicketTimersDeadlines
structs.doc: TicketTimersDeadlines types TicketTimers.deadlines.

structs.name: TicketTimersDeadlinesClose
structs.doc: TicketTimersDeadlinesClose types TicketTimersDeadlines.close.

structs.name: TicketTimersDeadlinesRespond
structs.doc: TicketTimersDeadlinesRespond types TicketTimersDeadlines.respond.

structs.name: TicketApprovals
structs.doc: TicketApprovals holds the fields a Ticket's Approvals adds, as a read returns them: a field with no value is absent.

members.name: Gates
members.doc: The sign-offs not yet consumed, by gated state: { <state>: { signedBy } }, each subject that signed, in the order they signed; a gate with none is absent.

structs.name: TicketApprovalsGates
structs.doc: TicketApprovalsGates types TicketApprovals.gates.

structs.name: TicketApprovalsGatesDone
structs.doc: TicketApprovalsGatesDone types TicketApprovalsGates.done.

structs.name: TicketNumbering
structs.doc: TicketNumbering holds the fields a Ticket's Numbering adds, as a read returns them: a field with no value is absent.

members.name: Seq
members.doc: The instance's number in its count, from 1; absent until it is numbered.

members.name: Label
members.doc: The number as the format prints it, unique within its scope; absent until it is numbered.

structs.doc: TicketAcmeRating holds the fields a Ticket's acme.Rating adds, as a read returns them: a field with no value is absent.

members.name: RatingCount
members.doc: How many ratings the item has.

members.name: RatingAverage
members.doc: The mean rating; 0 before the first.

structs.doc: WorkerPresence holds the fields a Worker's Presence adds, as a read returns them: a field with no value is absent.

members.name: Deadline
members.doc: When the instance is missed unless it is beaten, in epoch milliseconds: ttlMs after its create or its last beat; absent on an instance made before the schema composed Presence, until its first beat.

members.name: LastBeatAt
members.doc: When the instance was last beaten, in epoch milliseconds; absent before the first beat.

members.name: Missed
members.doc: Whether the instance missed its deadline and has not been beaten since.

members.name: Released
members.doc: The instances whose lease the last miss expired, by schema; absent before a miss.
